papers.title: Advances in Agentic Computer Graphics
papers.summary: This report proposes a unified taxonomy and literature system for agentic computer graphics driven by large language models, analyzing trends and open challenges in human-agent collaboration and long-horizon planning.
papers.summary_zh: 提出智能体计算机图形学的统一分类体系与文献梳理，分析人机协作与长程规划的趋势和挑战。

papers.title: Wave Forcing: Towards Speed-of-Light Streaming Video Generation
papers.summary: Wave Forcing enables efficient continuous long-video generation with consistent appearance and natural motion through co-designed generation, training, and execution, achieving high throughput and quality.
papers.summary_zh: Wave Forcing通过生成、训练与执行的协同设计，实现高吞吐、外观一致、运动自然的连续长视频生成。

papers.title: CUA-Master: Scaling Computer-use Agents through Open-World Recursive Improvements
papers.summary: CUA-Master uses nested recursive loops with open-world data and feedback-driven retries to continuously improve computer-use agents across diverse benchmarks.
papers.summary_zh: CUA-Master用嵌套递归循环、开放世界数据与反馈驱动的重试，持续提升跨多个基准的计算机操作智能体。

papers.title: CoworkOS:Scaling Agent Coworkers for Real-world Automation
papers.summary: CoworkOS is a long-horizon agent harness that separates strategy from execution, supports human-in-the-loop collaboration via shared artifacts, and improves model performance through sustained automated post-training.
papers.summary_zh: CoworkOS是长程智能体框架，分离策略与执行，借共享产物支持人机协作，并通过持续自动后训练提升模型。

papers.title: Video Generation Meets Agent Harness: Agentic Video Generation, Agentic World Modeling and Recursive Self-Improvement
papers.summary: Agent harnesses integrate video generation and world models to enable planning, tool use, and recursive self-improvement for autonomous multi-shot video production.
papers.summary_zh: 提出结合视频生成与世界模型的智能体框架，支持规划、工具调用与递归自我改进，用于自主多镜头视频制作。

papers.title: Democratizing Robot-Use Agents: A Unified Harness with Open Models
papers.summary: Uni-robot-agent enables open-weight robot-use agents to surpass proprietary models in zero-shot manipulation and suggests joint development of four core capabilities for future training.
papers.summary_zh: Uni-robot-agent统一框架让开源机器人智能体在零样本操作上超越闭源模型，并提出未来训练的四项核心能力。

papers.title: SWE-Trail: History-Guided Trajectory Collection for Coding Agent Training
papers.summary: SWE-Trail improves trajectory collection for coding agents by using past rollouts to guide exploration without exposing history to the agent, yielding better-trained student models.
papers.summary_zh: SWE-Trail利用历史轨迹引导代码智能体探索并采集数据，且不向智能体暴露历史，从而训练出更好的学生模型。

papers.title: NorthCUA Technical Report: Turbocharging Computer-Use Agents through Experience at Scale
papers.summary: NorthCUA scales computer-use agents via an experience flywheel, recursive self-improvement, staged learning, and reinforcement learning to achieve state-of-the-art open-source GUI and web interaction results.
papers.summary_zh: NorthCUA通过经验飞轮、递归自我改进、分阶段学习与强化学习扩展计算机操作智能体，在开源GUI与网页交互上达到SOTA。

papers.title: PhotoGuider: Composition-Aware Cropping and 360^{circ} View Framing with Explainable Photographic Assessments
papers.summary: PhotoGuider selects viewing directions and frames 360° panoramas using shared composition-aware tokens and produces camera-parameter outputs with explanation-conditioned scoring.
papers.summary_zh: PhotoGuider利用共享的构图感知表示选择360°全景的观看方向并取景，输出相机参数，并以解释为条件进行评分。

papers.title: Lost in Recovery: Demystifying Recovery Behavior of Computer-Use Agents via Goal-Oriented Action Replay
papers.summary: ReTrace is a framework that evaluates recovery behavior in computer-use agents by formalizing transition-consistent recovery and demonstrating that autonomous model-based recovery improves long-horizon reliability.
papers.summary_zh: ReTrace提出评估计算机操作智能体恢复行为的框架，形式化转换一致的恢复，并证明基于模型的自主恢复可提升长程可靠性。

papers.title: Order-Only On-Policy Distillation
papers.summary: Order-only on-policy distillation trains students to match teacher token rankings rather than probabilities, improving reasoning performance without temperature tuning.
papers.summary_zh: 提出仅基于排序的同策略蒸馏，让学生模仿教师的token排序而非概率，无需调温即可提升推理性能。

papers.title: IdeaTaste: Do LLMs Share the Research Taste of Human Researchers?
papers.summary: IdeaTaste benchmarks LLM research proposals against future publications, revealing that AI agents match human communities in broad directions but fall far behind in concrete approaches and expected success.
papers.summary_zh: IdeaTaste用未来论文检验LLM研究构想，发现智能体在大方向上与人类研究社区一致，但在具体方法和成功预期上差距很大。

papers.title: Reviso: Not All Visual Evidence Deserves Equal Attention in Video Captioning
papers.summary: Reviso is an agentic video captioning framework that learns to prioritize key visual evidence through hierarchical planning and active perception, improving caption quality and downstream video understanding.
papers.summary_zh: Reviso是智能体式视频字幕框架，通过分层规划与主动感知学习优先关注关键视觉证据，提升字幕质量与下游理解。

papers.title: When Does Latent Prediction Error Support Physical Surprise Claims in Video World Models?
papers.summary: The study evaluates frozen video representations to show that prediction errors reflect appearance and motion rather than reliably measuring physical surprise.
papers.summary_zh: 通过冻结的视频表示评估潜在预测误差，发现其主要反映外观与运动，无法可靠衡量物理意义上的惊讶。

papers.title: From Fragmentation to Fusion: A Survey and Roadmap for Omnimodal Embeddings
papers.summary: Embedding research across modalities is converging toward shared principles via contrastive learning and Transformers, and a framework of coverage, comparability, and compositionality is proposed to unify it through transformation, alignment, and joint embedding.
papers.summary_zh: 综述全模态嵌入研究，提出覆盖性、可比性与组合性框架，通过变换、对齐与联合嵌入统一不同模态的表示学习。

papers.title: CrossSWE: Benchmarking Cross-Repository Joint Development for Coding Agents
papers.summary: CrossSWE introduces a multi-repository benchmark showing that current LLMs struggle with cross-repository consistency during joint software development.
papers.summary_zh: CrossSWE构建跨代码库的多仓库基准，显示当前LLM在跨仓库联合开发中难以保持一致性。

papers.title: Diagnosing the Reference Gap: What Visual Scaffolds Can and Cannot Fix in Multimodal Reasoning
papers.summary: Multimodal language models fail at multi-step visual reasoning due to a reference gap rather than perception, and task-matched external references like numbering significantly improve accuracy without training.
papers.summary_zh: 研究表明多模态模型的多步视觉推理失败源于参照缺口而非感知，任务匹配的外部参照（如编号）无需训练即可显著提升准确率。

papers.title: FLAMIA: FLAsh MIcroscaling Attention for Fast and Causally Safe Training on Blackwell
papers.summary: FLAMIA accelerates Transformer attention on NVIDIA Blackwell GPUs via MXFP8 and mixed-precision kernels that reduce quantization overhead, prevent causal leakage, and support variable-length packed documents.
papers.summary_zh: FLAMIA在Blackwell GPU上通过MXFP8与混合精度内核加速Transformer注意力，减少量化开销，防止因果泄漏并支持变长打包文档。

papers.title: Avatar Intelligence: Amplifying Human Agency Through Persistent Personal Agents
papers.summary: Personal AI agents are increasingly capable of handling long-horizon tasks across applications, yet users often need to invest substantial effort in specifying goals, resolving ambiguity, and verifying outcomes. We argue that progress should be measured by how effectively agents amplify human agency
papers.summary_zh: 提出Avatar Intelligence，主张衡量个人智能体的进展应看其能否有效放大人的主体性，减少用户在目标设定与验证上的负担。

papers.title: DecisionRank: On-Policy Distillation for Decision-Model Rerankers
papers.summary: DecisionRank uses item-space on-policy distillation to transfer ranking knowledge from generative teachers to efficient decision models, achieving state-of-the-art retrieval performance with significantly faster inference.
papers.summary_zh: DecisionRank用物品空间同策略蒸馏，把生成式教师的排序知识迁移到高效决策模型，实现SOTA检索效果并大幅加速推理。
